notes.title: Ver 2.5.5a Update
notes.notes:
[h2]Application[/h2]
[h3]New Features[/h3]
[list]
[*]A switch has been added on the title screen of the Steam version to prevent the room key from being displayed.
[/list]

[h3]Bug Fixes[/h3]
[list]
[*]Fixed a bug that prevented NicoNico videos from being played on the Web Video Player. Also, fixed an error that was displayed on some NicoNico videos and YouTube videos.
[*]Fixed an issue where the MatcapColor setting of the VRM 1.0 MToon material was not being reflected in the rendering on Virtualcast.
[/list]
[h2]Studio[/h2]
[h3]Bug Fixes[/h3]
[list]
[*]Fixed a bug where the color of the marker pen was different in the left and right eye views and was not correctly displayed.
[/list]
[h2]VCI[/h2]
[h3]New Features[/h3]
[list]
[*]Added API to determine if the local stream camera is being grabbed.
    [url=https://developer.virtualcast.jp/vci-docs/api/classes/ExportLocalStreamCamera/IsGrabbed.html]Please check here for details[/url].
[*]Added API to get the texture of the preview video of the local stream camera.
    [url=http://developer.virtualcast.jp/vci-docs/api/classes/ExportLocalStreamCamera/GetPreviewTextureId.html]Please check here for details[/url].
[*]Added API to determine if the player is a room owner or room administrator.
    [url=http://developer.virtualcast.jp/vci-docs/api/classes/ExportRoomPlayer/IsRoomOwner.html]Detail Link 1[/url]
    [url=http://developer.virtualcast.jp/vci-docs/api/classes/ExportRoomPlayer/IsRoomAdmin.html]Detail Link 2[/url]
[*]Added an API to send a message to your own VCI instance.
    [url=http://developer.virtualcast.jp/vci-docs/api/classes/ExportMessage/EmitToSelf.html]Please check here for details[/url]
[/list]
[h3]Bug Fixes[/h3]
[list]
[*]Fixed a bug where the same error warning would be generated in large quantities when an error occurred in the Lua script.
[/list]
[h2]Web[/h2]
[h3]Bug Fixes[/h3]
[list]
[*]Fixed a bug that caused the display to break in each input field of the asset list and product management page.
[/list]

notes.title: Ver 2.5.4a Update
notes.notes:

[h3]Changes[/h3]

[*]Temporarily disabled mirrors in loading space to reduce its heavy load.

[*]Fixed an issue in the Quest version that caused the application to crash when the web video player was played for a long period of time.

[/list]
[h2]Web[/h2]
[h3]Changes[/h3]
[list]
[*]The acquisition of library assets has been sped up.
[/list]
[h3]Bug Fixes[/h3]

[*]Fixed a bug that the URL "x.com" could not be registered in the embedded contents field of the product information.
[*]Fixed a problem where the shadow of the asset viewer was becoming completely black compared to previous versions.
[*]Fixed a bug that caused an unexpected error when setting the same video URL multiple times.
[*]Fixed a problem on the Asset Edit page where thumbnail images were applied even if Cancel was pressed after taking a thumbnail from the preview.
[*]Fixed a problem that when uploading a new asset, if you upload and register the thumbnail image, it will not appear to have been applied.
[*]Fixed a problem where the active status of yourself, even when logged in, is always shown as offline.
[/list]

notes.title: [Beta] Ver 2.2.1a Changes in physics
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34269075/cde53fe0e915d786ad8867597a92ec9b35b20bf8.png[/img]
[quote]This article is a release note for [url=https://beta.virtualcast.jp/]VirtualCast Beta[/url].
For information on how to play Beta, see [url=https://virtualcast.jp/wiki/doku.php?id=en:tips:beta]here[/url].[/quote]

[h2]Room/Studio[/h2]
[h3]Bug fixes[/h3]
[list]
[*] Fixed the issue where, if you are using a Windows Mixed Reality HMD, looking at a specific angle caused your avatar to turn instantly in the opposite direction.
[*] Fixed the issue where the application occasionally crashed while loading VRMs.
[/list]
[h2]Room[/h2]
[h3]New Features[/h3]
[list]
[*] "Linear" type has been added to the rotation type, which will gradually change the rotation speed depending on the angle of the controller input.
[/list]
[h2]Changes[/h2]
[list]
[*] You can now attract the camera monitor.
[*] Holding your hand over a global stream camera and local stream camera that are locked will now show the red highlight, which indicates that it is not attractable. 
[*] Changed the character physics in Rooms.
[list][*] Changed the mass of characters.
[*] Changed the inertia behavior when jumping.
[/list][/list]
[h3]Bug fixes[/h3]
[list]
[*] Fixed the issue where the first person offset is not applied to the characters when using a VRM with its value set.
[*] Fixed the issue where moving from a studio to a room while using a VRM with its first-person offset changed causes the graphic to distort.
[/list]
[h2]VCI[/h2]
[h3]Changes[/h3]
[list]
[*] Added overloads to VciTransform.AddForce: vci.forceMode.Force and vci.forceMode.Impulse.
[list][*] Due to this, the traditional overload which receives one argument becomes obsolete.
[*] By using this API, you can suppress the difference in physical behavior derived from the FPS difference. 
[*] Also, to adapt to the change in execution order due to this change, the execution timing of VciTransform.SetVelocity and VciTransform.SetAngularVelocity has been adjusted.
[/list][/list]
[h3]Bug Fixes[/h3]
[list]
[*] Fixed the issue where a Lua script stops running when a stack overflow occurs in the Lua script.
[*] Fixed the issue where you could transfer the ownership of the part of subitems that belongs to the same GroupID.
[/list]
[h2]Web[/h2]
[h3]New Features[/h3]
[list]
[*] You can now change the protocol to use when connecting to Rooms.
[list][*] You can change this setting from [url=https://room.virtualcast.jp/settings]here[/url]. You might be able to solve the problem of not being able to enter a room properly by changing this setting.
[/list][/list]

notes.title: [Beta] Ver 2.0.8b Changes on VCI
notes.notes:
[h2]Rooms[/h2]
[h3]Changes[/h3]
[list]
[*] To improve the stability of the server, we have applied limitations to some synchronization APIs in VCI.
[list][*] This is a counteraction against some VCIs that could overload the entire sync server and shut it down in the former sync systems. 
[*] We will be adjusting this limitation as we go as we want everyone to play VirtualCast comfortably.
[/list]
[*] Here are the limitations in specific.
[list][*] APIs starting with _ALL_, such as _ALL_SetText, will have a sendable character limitation of 512 bytes (in UTF-8).
[list][*] This is about 500 alphabetical characters or about 250 Japanese characters.
[*] If you need to display a large number of texts, please use vci.state or vci.message API to synchronize.[/list]
[*] vci.message can send a text of up to 4000 bytes (in UTF-8).
[*] The amount of data you can share with vci.state is up to 16KB.
[/list][/list]
[h2]VCI[/h2]
[h3]Bug fixes[/h3]
[list]
[*] Fixed the issue where the emission value of VCI items that use standard shader turned into a non-HDR value. 
[*] Fixed the issue where the color of VCI items using unlit shader becomes lighter. 
[*] Fixed the issue where looking at a VCI from long-distance caused its texture to flicker.
[/list]

[*] When the white line hits the item you want to attract, the item will start to light up (If the item is not attractable, the item will not light up)
[*] While in that state, press the grip button on the controller to attract the item toward you[/list]
[*] You can now specify the studio you want to visit beforehand from the Web page.

[*] The photos taken in Room will be named [{Date}_{Room name}_{Name of photographer}]
[*] Changed the order of preset items in Studio

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34269075/6cbbfef0a8e2e48cea74578fa0eddf32a2407afb.png[/img]

Copy the code displayed on THE SEED ONLINE connection page, paste the code on the input field in VirtualCast and click [Next] to complete the steps.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34269075/66f4729b3525347bb7adc2f79be4304a4f7cca70.png[/img]
[h2]New Features[/h2]
[list]
[*] Released the Room feature.
[list][*] Currently the user interface is available in Japanese only. English localization is coming soon.
[*]For details, see these articles(Japanese):
[list][*] [url=https://steamcommunity.com/linkfilter/?url=https://virtualcast.jp/wiki/virtualcast/room]VirtualCast wiki About Room[/url]
[*] [url=https://virtualcast.jp/blog/2020/11/room_startguide_easy/]Room: Quick Guide[/url]
[*] [url=https://virtualcast.jp/blog/2020/11/room_startguide_stepup/]Room: Step-up Guide[/url]
[/list][/list]
[*] You can now specify the type of the controllers you are using in the settings screen(Only valid in the Room).
[list][*] The default is auto-detect
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34269075/cc4a3f8a375c17fea1a9b3878d14cb4910bcd601.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34269075/47d144dc0c3e16d18e61501b4572f5fca9286c12.png[/img]
[/list]
[*] Added HUD feature on the Room
[list][*] You can see your mic volume and current facial expression on the HUD when this feature is enabled
[*] For details, see [url=https://virtualcast.jp/wiki/virtualcast/room/ringmenu/system/hud][HUD Display][/url].
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34269075/b03faf46fe436c19acdf090119bbb528b25ceee3.png[/img]
[/list]
[*] You can now purchase VRMs from the character context menu in the Room.
[list][*] Point the hand laser toward a character to open the character context menu. You can purchase the VRM from the context menu.
[*] Note, if the VRM's license limits the use of the avatar to "the author only," you can not purchase it in VR.
[*] A VRM can be purchased if it is merchandised in The Seed Online.
[/list]
[*] Added block feature in the Room
[list][*] You can add a user to the block list from the Room page on the Web, the Participants list in the ring menu or the context menu opened by selecting a character.[/list]
[*] Added purchase history in the ring menu
[list][*] You can select items and characters purchased from within VR.[/list]
[*]  Added Photo Capture in the Room
[list][*] This feature allows you to take photos in the Room and post it to Twitter
[*] For details, see[url=https://virtualcast.jp/wiki/virtualcast/room/camera%22] How to operate in-Room camera[/url](Currently in Japanese only)
[previewyoutube=Zck7LM5kRlE;full][/previewyoutube]
[/list]
[h2]Changes[/h2]
[list]
[*] From now on, press and hold the menu button while touching an item to open a context menu.
[list][*] This change is made to avoid the context menu from popping up unintendedly by pressing the menu button while an attachable VCI is attached near your hands. This allows you to open the ring menu anytime by just pressing the menu button shortly.[/list]
[*] Unified the naming convention of images exported from whiteboard to that of images exported from capture camera. 
[*] Changed the display speed of button texts and ticker messages in the ring menu.
[*] Changed the controller binding for Grip and Use on Index controllers.
[table]
    [tr]
        [th][Before][/th]
        [th][After][/th]
    [/tr]
    [tr]
        [td]Press the trigger to Grip[/td]
        [td]Squeeze the controller to Grip[/td]
    [/tr]
    [tr]
        [td]Press A to Use[/td]
        [td]Press the trigger to Use[/td]
    [/tr]
[/table]	
[*] Made an internal improvement on the rotation speed and locomotion speed settings.
[*]You can now use VRMs "Authorized only to explicitly specified person" purchased in THE SEED ONLINE.
[list][*] Provided that the VRM is purchased on THE SEED ONLINE, you can use it as your avatar even when the VRM's license is set to "Authorized only to explicitly specified person."[/list]
[*] Fixed the error message that indicates the modification of lifespan is prohibited by the set privilege.
[list][*] When changing the lifespan of a VCI, you will be shown an error message if you do not have the privilege to execute that operation. The message has been reworded so that you can understand it more easily.[/list]
[/list]
[h2]Improvements[/h2]
[list]
[*] Changed the maximum length of the hand laser from 10m to 20m.
[*] Changed the laser shooting out of context menu to follow the object of interest.
[*] Optimized the ring menu to reduce the frame drop while manipulating it.
[*] When selecting a room on the ring menu, you can now see why you cannot enter a certain room (the room is full, you have no access right, etc.) before actually entering it.
[*] You will be notified when you couldn't enter the room because the room is full.
[*] The ReflectionProbe is now enabled in the Room
[list][*] This allows for rendering of accurate reflection on metallic materials in the Room[/list]
[*] You can now enable snapping of item rotation in the Room
[list][*] Snap toggle button is added in the context menu
[*] When the snap is enabled, the item will turn by 15 degrees while being grabbed[/list]
[*] Added a feature to load compressed textures when loading characters in the Room
[list][*] In the settings page, select [Graphics] > [Reduce memory usage for character rendering] to enable this feature
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34269075/563d2b57f23afd4b3b98ebf49d4971c3ca5d0532.png[/img]
[*] This feature will compress the textures on character models to reduce memory consumption.
[*] Enabling this will reduce the memory usage, but it will lower the texture quality.[/list]
[*] You can now add a room to favorites from the context menu of a link object.
[*] Improved the download speed of THE SEED ONLINE items by compressing data.
[/list]
[/list]
[h2]Bug fixes[/h2]
[list]
[*] Fixed the issue where sometimes unintended button was displayed outside of the ring.
[*] Fixed the issue where sometimes the "VCI LOADING" object kept existing even after the VCI is deleted.
[*] Fixed the issue where an image on the queue card was not visible from a certain angle when the opacity of the queue card is set to 100%.
[*] Fixed the issue where you sometimes couldn't enter official studios properly (turns completely black).
[*] Fixed the issue where pressing the trigger lightly while in the finger paint mode disables the finger paint mode.
[*] Fixed the issue where the sound effect was not played when a VCI is deleted.
[*] Fixed the issue where the nameplate's voice indicator did not turn off when the mic mute is enabled while speaking.
[*] Fixed the issue where the FOV of a camera is not synced when entering a studio.
[*] Fixed the issue where grabbing a VCI item with gravity settings while the item is being attracted resulted in the item to be blown away.
[*] Fixed the issue where you couldn't load VCIs when you were running Windows in certain languages.
[*] Fixed the issue where you sometimes couldn't load VCI locations in the official studios.
[*] Fixed the issue where you couldn't change the multi-line while buttons are being loaded in the ring menu.
[*] Fixed an issue where a certain type of characters contained in a tweet caused an error.
[/list]
[h2]VCI[/h2]
For details, see these articles
[url=https://virtualcast.jp/wiki/doku.php?id=vci:updatelog:2.0.0b]VirtualCast2.0.0b VCI Update[/url]
[url=https://virtualcast.jp/wiki/vci/updatelog/2.0.1a]VirtualCast2.0.1a VCI Update[/url]
[h3]Improvements[/h3]
[list]
[*] You can now keep the show/hide setting of the VCI debug console between studios.
[list][*] Due to this change, your current setting will be reset to "disabled."
[*] Due to this change, the [VCI Debug] button in the ring menu > [System] will always be visible regardless of the setting in the title settings > [VCI] > [Display debug information in studio].
[/list]
[*] vci.assets.GetInstanceId() has been added with which you can acquire the unique ID of a VCI instance.
[*] You can now send and receive tables with VCI messages.
[*] vci.message.EmitWithId() has been added to allow you to specify the destination of the message.
[*] Adjusted the repulsion behavior of VCIs which has its IsKinematic value set to true
[*] You can now distinguish `Oculus Quest 2` with vci.me.GetHeadMountedDisplayName()
[/list]
[h3]Changes[/h3]
[list]
[*] Updated [url=https://effekseer.github.io/jp/]Effekseer[/url] to v1.52n.
[*] Added SetActive in VciTransform
[list][*] SetActive, ActiveSelf and ActiveInHierarchy is added in VCITransform.[/list]
[*] Added VCAST_materials_pbr extension
[list][*] Now, the Intensity value of HDR is applied on the EmissionColor of standard material.
[/list][/list]
[h3]Bug fixes[/h3]
[list]
[*] Fixed the issue where a json containing escaped slash cannot be parsed.
[*] Improved the loading speed of VRMs and VCIs in Room.
[/list]

notes.title: Ver 1.8.1a release
notes.notes:
[h1][b]New features[/b][/h1]
[list][*] Added experimental motion filter feature
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34269075/9feb599582d85a214bb4121c5ba653be52f89ed9.png[/img]
Can be enabled from [System] > [Motion Filter]

[*] User height setting is added along with the motion filter feature
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34269075/3396fb858c8e5cec2f17f5cbcfe30806c2dfab8b.png[/img]
You can set the height on the calibration screen
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34269075/d7ffca175473fb6f6190fe58a0af862da747dfd3.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34269075/329d82612fcbfefaac74cba32db9fc924a8c4b08.png[/img]
The height can be changed within VR from [System] > [User Height]
※The new setting will be applied after changing a character
[/list]
[quote]When the motion filter is enabled, the user height is used to compensate for the physical difference between the real-world user and the VR-world avatar. This feature works even when you are seated on a chair; the physical difference is compensated based on the user height you have set.
※Depending on the broadness of the shoulder and the length of the hand of the avatar, it may result in the positional difference between the controller and the hand of the avatar. 
※The motion filter is an experimental feature. It will continue to be improved.
[/quote]

[h1][b]Bug fix[/b][/h1]

[*] When the connection to voice server is temporarily disconnected, it now automatically attempts to reconnect.

[*] Double-byte space will not be displayed on comments from now on
[*] Fixed the issue where the roughness of the item "Mosaic" is not synced.

[/list]

    [*]After this fix, the version of VCI at the time of the initial load will continue to be loaded even after updating the VCI file on THE SEED. To load the latest VCI on THE SEED, delete the VCI in the room, and re-enter the room, then reload the VCI. You can also reload the VCI with the Reload feature in the context menu. [/list]

[u][b][h1]About the voice system[/h1][/b][/u]
[h1]【Studio 3D audio】[/h1]
A new setting to change the studio audio to 3D is added to "Ring Menu" > [System] > [Studio settings] (Currently, this affects voice only)
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34269075/a05548708ff6c4d937e9276e90cb7e9fa338c7fe.png[/img]
[list][*] 3D audio
[list][*] Add spacial audio effect to the sounds in the studio (Currently, this affects voice only)[/list]

[list][*] When 3D audio is enabled, you can specify the distance at which sounds starts to get softer and the longest distance to which sounds can reach

[*] Max Distance: Specify the maximum distance that a sound can reach to (in meter)[/list][/list][/list]

[h1]【Voice settings】[/h1]
New voice features are added with the renovation of the voice system
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34269075/0dabdf81c2b2b5400549b71467398017ef552dce.png[/img]

[list][*]Audio pre-processor
[list][*]Removes environment noise to make the sound cleaner
[*]By enabling, you can use the following features
[list][*]Reverb reducer
[list][*]Removes reverberation (Room echo, etc.) from the input[/list]
[*]Voice detection
[list][*]A feature to detect your speech
[*]It detects your speech and turns on/off the input accordingly[/list]
[*]Auto gain adjustment
[list][*]Automatically adjust the mic input to the appropriate volume[/list]
[*]When the pre-processor is enabled, stationary noises such as wind blow from an air-conditioner or sound from a light source will be reduced[/list][/list]
[list][*]Echo canceller
[list][*]Reduces residual echo
[*]It also has the feature to reduce the volume of output while you are talking[/list][/list][/list]
